name: What common trip hazards are found in a kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What common trip hazards are found in a kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common kitchen trip hazards include loose floor tiles, uneven flooring transitions, damaged linoleum or vinyl, worn-out carpets or rugs, and improperly secured wires or cables. Water spills and debris can also create temporary hazards. Identifying and addressing these issues promptly helps prevent falls and ensures a safer kitchen environment for everyone.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common kitchen trip hazards include loose tiles, uneven flooring, damaged surfaces, and unsecured wires.
